It runs from the planned Socrates South power plant in New Albany, Licking County, to an Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage interconnect in Liberty Township, Fairfield County. The filing notice is a PDF from a township mailing. No existing row in the tracker matches any Aristotle or Will-Power line. Data center tie: a June 2025 Pipeline and Gas Journal report says the Socrates South plant serves an adjacent Meta-affiliated data center and will get gas from two 24-inch pipelines to be filed separately. The Williams project page lists Aristotle South among the Socrates power solution facilities. No single page states outright that this pipeline serves the data center, so the tie is by way of the plant and the confidence is medium. Approval status of the pipeline case was not found, so status is proposed. Capacity, cost and start year were not found. The owner name is spelled in the ownership team's style; the entity is not in the owner list yet. No route was mapped. Two sibling lines, Aristotle Central and Aristotle North, are separate cases.

pipeline: Tiger Gas Pipeline / Richland Parish Lateral
notes: Energy Transfer and Entergy Louisiana signed a 20-year firm transport deal in November 2025. A 12-mile lateral off the Tiger Pipeline, up to 1 billion cubic feet per day, serves new Entergy gas plants and Meta's data center in Richland Parish. Trade press (Pipeline and Gas Journal, November 2025) names the lateral and the Meta data center. The Energy Information Administration August 2026 pipeline projects table (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 123, listed as Tiger Pipeline Expansion Project) gives 12 miles, 1,000 million cubic feet per day, proposed, in service 2028, intrastate, and ties it to Entergy Louisiana's data center power plant. The Entergy press release was read and also describes the agreement. This is not P5849 (the operating 2011 Tiger expansion) and not P0265 (the main line). It is new pipe, so it is its own row. Start location was not stated by a source, so it is left blank. Delhi comes from the trade press as the delivery point. Capacity is 1,000 million cubic feet per day as the maximum; the firm contract is 250,000 MMBtu per day. Diameter, owner entity and cost were not found. The company holding the pipe is probably a Tiger Pipeline subsidiary of Energy Transfer, but no source names it, so Owner is left blank for the ownership team. A 13.24 mile figure from a FERC filing seen by one search was not verified and no FERC filing was found; EIA lists it as intrastate. Route not researched. Tier high: two independent sources agree on length and capacity. DataCenter is yes because trade press and EIA both name the Meta/Entergy data center supply.

pipeline: El Paso Gas Pipeline / McCloud Lateral Project
notes: EPNG filed a prior notice with the federal gas regulator on July 30, 2026 (docket CP26-558) for a lateral about 5.8 miles long and 16 inches wide in El Paso County, Texas. It would carry up to 167,000 Dth per day from EPNG's south mainline to a new McCloud Meter Station and cost $20.3 million. The notice says only that the gas goes to a planned power generation facility. It does not name a data center. A Kinder Morgan open season posted in March 2026 offers the same 167,000 Dth per day, with Enchanted Rock as the receipt point and a target start of January 1, 2027. Enchanted Rock builds the McCloud gas plant that El Paso Electric is proposing for Meta's El Paso data center, and the Texas Tribune confirms that plant exists and is meant for the data center. One analyst post (Measured AI) ties the open season to that plant directly, using El Paso Electric's filing that names Kinder Morgan as its gas supplier and a matching delivery fee. No regulator or company document names the lateral and the data center together, so the data center tie is medium confidence. Not the same as existing rows: South Mainline Expansion (P2617) is a different, finished project, and Norte Crossing (P2568) is a different line. This is a new expansion row on the El Paso Gas Pipeline. Owner spelling follows the ownership team style (El Paso Natural Gas Company LLC). The open season states a 5-mile, 16 inch lateral and the filing states 5.8 miles, so the filing figure is used. No route was found. Start year is not staged because the January 2027 date is a target only. Status is proposed because the prior notice has no approval yet.
